sources.topic_1: Student Book - Writing (A film you have watched)
sources.topic_2: Activity Book - Writing (How people celebrate a new-born baby)

topics.title: Write a paragraph about a film you have watched.
guiding_questions: What is the name of the film?
topics.sample_essay: Last week, I watched a wonderful film called 'The Lion King'. The main characters were Simba and his father. The film was about a young lion who lost his father and became a king. It ended happily when Simba returned to his home. I liked it because it was exciting and taught me about courage and family.

topics.title: Write a paragraph describing how people celebrate a new-born baby in your country.
guiding_questions: What do people do when a baby is born?
topics.sample_essay: In my country, when a new baby is born, all the family and friends visit the house. They bring gifts and flowers for the baby and the mother. People cook special food and sweets. The family gives sweets to the neighbours. Everyone is very happy and they say nice words to the new baby. It is a wonderful tradition.
